# Security Policy
This file explains how to report security issues in this project.

## Reporting an Issue
- If you discover a security issue, report it immediately.
- Provide as much detail as possible, including steps to reproduce the issue.

## What to Include
- Description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce the problem
- Any relevant screenshots

## Response
- Security issues will be reviewed as soon as possible.
- A fix or mitigation plan will be communicated within the team as soon as possible.
